# three.js model readers

`three-GLTFLoader-r128.js`, `three-OBJLoader-r128.js` and `three-STLLoader-r128.js` are the unmodified `examples/js/loaders/` files of three.js r128 (npm `three@0.128.0`), matching the r128 core the page loads from cdnjs. They attach to the global `THREE`. `js/world-objects.js` loads one only when a model of its kind is first read. MIT licence: `three-LICENSE`.
